name: AI Company — Product & Market
desc: Product strategy, competitive landscape, and go-to-market context for a frontier AI company.

nodes.label: AI Safety Leadership
nodes.desc: Position as the responsible AI leader. Build trust through transparency, research publication, and safety-first development practices.

nodes.label: Enterprise Adoption
nodes.desc: Drive enterprise revenue through API platform, reliability guarantees, and compliance-ready deployments.

nodes.label: Developer Ecosystem
nodes.desc: Build a thriving developer community with best-in-class APIs, SDKs, and documentation.

nodes.label: Research Moat
nodes.desc: Maintain frontier capabilities through Constitutional AI, RLHF advances, and novel architectures.

nodes.label: Claude API
nodes.desc: Primary revenue driver. REST API with streaming, function calling, vision, and 200K context window.

nodes.label: Claude.ai
nodes.desc: Web interface for direct consumer access. Pro tier with extended usage and priority access.

nodes.label: Claude for Enterprise
nodes.desc: SSO, admin controls, usage analytics, data isolation, custom fine-tuning. SOC 2 compliant.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.desc: CLI-based agentic coding assistant. Terminal-native workflow for developers.

nodes.label: Model Context Protocol
nodes.desc: Open protocol enabling AI models to connect with external tools and data sources seamlessly.

nodes.label: Claude 4 Development
nodes.desc: Next-generation model training. Focus on reasoning, reliability, and expanded multimodal capabilities.

nodes.label: Safety Evals Framework
nodes.desc: Comprehensive evaluation suite for model safety, bias detection, and capability assessment.

nodes.label: Enterprise Onboarding
nodes.desc: Streamline enterprise sales cycle from 6 weeks to 2 weeks with self-serve provisioning.

nodes.label: Agentic Systems
nodes.desc: Multi-step autonomous agent capabilities with tool use, planning, and execution monitoring.

nodes.label: Trustworthy AI
nodes.desc: Core brand narrative: the AI you can trust. Safety, honesty, and helpfulness as differentiators.

nodes.label: Developer Relations
nodes.desc: Conference talks, open-source contributions, technical blog posts, and community engagement.

nodes.label: Enterprise Case Studies
nodes.desc: Published case studies from Fortune 500 deployments showcasing ROI and reliability.

nodes.label: Research Publications
nodes.desc: Peer-reviewed papers and blog posts establishing technical credibility and safety commitment.

nodes.label: Constitutional AI
nodes.desc: Models trained to be helpful, harmless, and honest through constitutional principles rather than pure RLHF.

nodes.label: Responsible Scaling
nodes.desc: Committed to pausing scaling if safety benchmarks are not met. Published RSP with concrete thresholds.

nodes.label: Transparency Reports
nodes.desc: Regular public reporting on model capabilities, safety incidents, and policy decisions.

nodes.label: Benefit Corporation
nodes.desc: Public Benefit Corporation structure aligning fiduciary duty with societal benefit.

nodes.label: Enterprise CTOs
nodes.desc: Risk-averse technology leaders at Fortune 500 companies evaluating AI deployment. Need reliability, compliance, support.

nodes.label: AI-Native Startups
nodes.desc: Fast-moving startups building products on top of Claude API. Price-sensitive, need cutting-edge features.

nodes.label: Individual Developers
nodes.desc: Solo devs and small teams exploring AI capabilities. Influence future enterprise decisions.

nodes.label: Research Institutions
nodes.desc: Universities and labs using Claude for research. Contribute to safety ecosystem and credibility.

nodes.label: OpenAI / GPT
nodes.desc: Market leader by brand recognition. Strong consumer product, broad enterprise adoption, aggressive pricing.

nodes.label: Google DeepMind
nodes.desc: Deepest research talent pool. Gemini models with multimodal strength. Distribution through Google Cloud.

nodes.label: Meta / LLaMA
nodes.desc: Open-weight models disrupting pricing. Strong adoption in research and cost-sensitive deployments.

nodes.label: Mistral AI
nodes.desc: European competitor with efficient models and strong enterprise traction, especially in EU markets.

nodes.label: AI Regulation Wave
nodes.desc: EU AI Act enforcement, US executive orders, and global regulatory frameworks reshaping deployment requirements.

nodes.label: Enterprise AI Budget
nodes.desc: Enterprise AI spending projected to reach $200B+ by 2025. Budget shifting from experimentation to production.

nodes.label: Open Source Pressure
nodes.desc: LLaMA, Mixtral, and others closing capability gap with closed models, pressuring API pricing.

nodes.label: Safety-Washing Backlash
nodes.desc: Growing skepticism of AI safety claims. Need to demonstrate genuine commitment vs. marketing.

nodes.label: Agentic AI Demand
nodes.desc: Explosion of demand for autonomous AI agents that can complete multi-step workflows independently.
